Jordan: Hey all — addressed the safety nit on request routing, removed the stale debug logs, and added a focused unit test. PTAL when you have a sec.
Mira: Thanks — quick Q: does the new test exercise the concurrent KV path that hit the race?
Jordan: Yep. I added a deterministic stress test that queues 50 parallel reads with the same key and asserts no corrupted cache state. Run locally with:
```
pytest tests/runtime/test_kv_race.py::test_parallel_reads -q
```
Jordan: Also added a short changelog note and updated the canary config to 1 replica for a faster turn.
Sam: Quick skim — looks good overall. Left one tiny nit to prefer structured logging (json fields) instead of an f-string for the error path.
Jordan: Nice catch, fixed in commit c3f4a2a and pushed. I kept the test timeout low so CI stays snappy.
merge-bot: Canary reserved: slot 2024-11-12T23:00Z — monitoring hook attached. If canary healthy for 10m it will promote. :rocket:
Mira: I can run the smoke script against staging after canary passes.
Jordan: Thanks! Who wants merge custody for the window? I'm happy to hand off.
Sam: I can take merge custody and watch the canary.
Jordan: Perfect — PTAL -> will merge once you confirm smoke passes. :thumbsup:
